description:
Son Claret Castle is a 19th-century manor-castle in the rural interior of Mallorca, in the municipality of Calvià, within the Serra de Tramuntana, a UNESCO World Heritage site. The original building was restored and expanded into a luxury hotel and member of The Leading Hotels of the World, the prestigious international association of independent high-end hotels.

The property sits on over 300 hectares of gardens and Mediterranean vegetation, offering a sharp contrast to Mallorca's better-known beach destinations — positioning itself as a luxury rural retreat in the island's interior.

The castle's setting within the UNESCO-listed Serra de Tramuntana gives Son Claret a formally recognized natural heritage backdrop, distinct from the coastal resorts more commonly associated with Mallorca tourism.

The property's membership in The Leading Hotels of the World, an association reserved for a curated set of independent luxury properties globally, gives Son Claret a specific international hospitality pedigree.

The estate's 300-plus hectares of gardens give guests staying at Son Claret a genuinely expansive private landscape, well beyond the immediate footprint of the historic manor building.

hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** In Es Capdellà, Calvià, in Mallorca's rural interior, Balearic Islands.

**Rooms & rates:** Rooms and suites (including suites with a private pool and garden views), blending historic elements with contemporary luxury; from about €705 per night.

**On-site:** Two pools, spa and wellness center with sauna and hammam, gym, tennis court, restaurant with à la carte vegetarian/vegan options, airport transfer, room service.

**Good to know:** The first castle-hotel on Mallorca in this collection and the first Leading Hotels of the World member among Spain's castle-hotels.

**Combine with:** The wider Serra de Tramuntana and Palma de Mallorca's old town.
